diagnosis: Acquired cystic disease–associated renal cell carcinoma
legend: The tumour forms a haemorrhagic mass in a cyst. There are numerous cysts in the background.

diagnosis: Acquired cystic disease–associated renal cell carcinoma
legend: The tumour shows tubulopapillary growth composed of abundant eosinophilic cells with a prominent nucleolus, some of which have intracytoplasmic or intercytoplasmic holes imparting sieve-like growth and calcium oxalate crystal deposition.

diagnosis: Acquired cystic disease associated renal cell carcinoma
legend: A tumor nodule in a cyst shows typical ACD- associated RCC. The solid area with necrosis in the bottom shows sarcomatoid component.
